usedFor: Shopify takes the orders, and Onfleet receives the delivery work as pickup or dropoff tasks through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create Task” in Onfleet
bestTemplate.why: A paid order is ready to ship, and the action creates a pickup or dropoff task.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling and has no order behind it, so do not point “Create Task” at it.
